settings.title: EBizCharge for Shopware 6.7
settings.description: Configure EBizCharge payment credentials and checkout behavior.
settings.sandboxBaseUrlHelpText: Confirm this value with EBizCharge. The supplied provider materials point at production/v2 even for sandbox credentials.
settings.processingCommandHelpText: Use Sale for the first simple sandbox transaction. Use AuthOnly when merchant policy requires authorization without immediate capture.
settings.paymentFlowHelpText: Choose whether customers are redirected to the EBizCharge hosted payment page or complete payment in an embedded iframe during checkout.
settings.shipFromZipHelpText: Required by the supplied provider certification guidance.
settings.enforceAvsCheckHelpText: When enabled, approved card payments are accepted only when EBizCharge returns a full AVS address and ZIP match.
settings.retryCount: Retry count for transient provider failures
settings.retryCountHelpText: Used only for network errors and provider 5xx responses. Maximum effective value is 3.
settings.webhookEndpointLabel: Webhook endpoint URL (to be configured by EBizCharge support)
settings.webhookEndpointHelpText: Copy this URL and send it to EBizCharge customer support when asking them to configure webhook delivery.
settings.webhookEndpointCopyError: The webhook endpoint URL could not be copied.

configValidation.bannerIntro: Please complete the required EBizCharge configuration fields before saving.
configValidation.requiredField: This field must not be empty.
configValidation.loadError: The EBizCharge configuration could not be loaded.
configValidation.saveError: An error occurred while saving your changes.
